title: OpenAI zero quota snapshot triggers quota auto-pause

preconditions: OpenAI quota auto-pause threshold is enabled
Codex quota probe/header snapshot contains primary and secondary used/reset/window values all zero
steps: select an OpenAI account with auto-pause defaults enabled
reproduction.expected: empty all-zero quota snapshot is treated as unknown/no usable signal and does not set temporary 429 unschedulable state
reproduction.actual: 5h raw zero is normalized to 100% used, crosses threshold, and SetRateLimited/temporary 429 unschedulable state is applied

progress.note: Capture bug basics and reproduction signals

progress.action: Skip canonical Codex used_percent updates for all-zero empty quota slots and verify auto-pause no longer triggers.
progress.note: The 5h header can be remaining percent, but 0/0/0 percent-reset-window is an empty snapshot, not an exhausted window.

progress.action: Archive bug with automated regression test
Add read-side guard so existing bad canonical zero-quota snapshots do not trigger auto-pause.
progress.note: Regression now covers both new all-zero snapshots and previously persisted codex_5h/7d_used_percent=100 derived from empty raw quota slots.

progress.action: Archive bug with automated regression test
